name: Future Fall
description:
About This Game

Future Fall is a story about the confrontation of 2 worlds, about how an alternative future penetrates through a time rift into the world of the protagonist and he is looking for a way to prevent it.

A man-made disaster has split the world into two realities. Wormholes arise between them, through which dangerous mutants and anomalies seep.

What awaits you:

Two worlds in one: Explore abandoned locations and an alternate reality full of anomalies and dangers.

Clan Wars: Team up with players, develop clans, and fight for resources and dominance.

Crafting System: Create weapons, armor, and equipment from found materials.

Anomalies and Wormholes: Open portals to other dimensions, collect unique artifacts, and take risks for powerful bonuses.

Dynamic gameplay: PvE quests, PvP battles, mutant raids, daily events.

Character Upgrade: Develop survival skills, combat skills, and special abilities.

Features:

realistic survival system (starvation, radiation, loss of consciousness);

deep clan mechanics (base rental, economy, trade);

a detailed open world with secret locations.

Become a legend of the exclusion zone — survive, unite and conquer the fractured world of Future Fall!
short_desc: Immerse yourself in the multiplayer post-apocalyptic world of Future Fall. Survive in the exclusion zone, explore the world, collect artifacts, upgrade, fight for resources and lead your clan to victory! Crafting, PvP, PvE and dynamic events are waiting for you
